data.name: Neverquest
data.detailed_description:
An vast open world to adventure in....

  • A Hand - Crafted World: Explore a massive seamless 2D map set in the high fantasy world of Minthra, with hand drawn pixel art and zero procedural generation. Discover forgotten lands, dungeons and distinct biomes that house the various Factions.

  • Six Iconic Factions: A dynamic faction system that changes your alignment as you defeat enemies. Certain NPCs, vendors, and towns will only aid allies, so choose wisely! But don’t stress, you can re-align faction at any point by defeating certain enemies (in large quantities of course!)

  • Biome-Centric Lands: Explore distinct regions of Minthra, each anchored by a dominant faction with a unique history, and unique enemies to battle.

  • Non-Linear Gameplay: Go anywhere at any time – your only limit is your character’s power. Relive the classic thrill of sprinting through dangerous, uncharted areas of the map, dodging high level monsters as you go!

Party & Guild System

  • Recruit NPC Companions: Build your dream adventuring party from your guild’s roster. Recruit companions with distinct personalities and randomized stat potential ranging from D-tier to legendary SS-tier.

  • Classic Trinity Dynamics: Command essential party roles - Tank, Healer, DPS - each with 3 distinct subclasses to build the ultimate group or raid party.

  • Massive 50-Player Raids: Scale up your forces as your guild levels up and direct 50 active guildmates in epic, screen-filling boss encounters with classic boss mechanics inspired by early 2000s MMORPGs.

  • Guild Progression: Earn guild XP alongside standard character XP to unlock deeper recruitment pools, larger roster caps and increased raid capacity.

  • Solo-Friendly MMO Feel: Recreate the magic of classic guild raiding and XP grouping without the overhead of scheduling. Your guildmates are always online, ready to group, and someone is always willing to play a Healer.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Real Time Combat & Magic

  • Fluid Real-Time Combat: Pull enemies to your party utilizing activated ranged attacks and projectile magic and then engage with an auto-attacking melee system while managing active spell rotations and party positioning.

  • Active Spellcasting: Command classic fantasy spell archetypes—including direct damage, damage-over-time (DoT), crowd control, direct heals, heal-over-time (HoT), buffs, and debuffs

  • Dice-Roll Mechanics: Experience table-top style RNG combat where every sword swing rolls between a min and max value based on your stats and equipped weapon.

  • Classic Stat Systems: Leverage a straightforward stat system based on hp, mana, Strength, dexterity, wisdom and armor class to optimize your character and fine-tune your build.

  • Builds and Synergy: Combine spells and abilities to form synergistic builds and maximize your character’s power.

Unrestricted Classes and Skills

  • Dual-XP Progression: Earn class XP 1:1 with regular XP to level up any class you choose

  • Classic Fantasy Archetypes: Choose spells and abilities from classes including Druid, Shadow Knight, Spirit Speaker (shaman), Ranger and Mage, with more to come.

  • Cross-Class Freedom: Equipping spells and passives isn't locked by class. Freely mix Shadow Knight dark magic with Druid heals, or pair Ranger buffs with Spirit Speaker debuffs directly on your spell bar.

  • Modular Spellcrafting: Collect spell components from open-world-drops to craft your own projectile magic spells. Combine a Base Spell, Travel Component and Impact Effect to create enemy-seeking energy orbs , or magic missiles that split on impact.

  • Evolving Companion Summons: Summon loyal pets to battle alongside you and your party. Pets progress through 5 visual power stages – from a humble and cute spirit animal, to a massive armored guardian.

  • Deep Passive Skill Trees: Tailor your playstyle using a vast passive skill tree divided into Utility, Combat & Casting, and powerful Pinnacle traits to unlock build synergies.

  • Build Prestige and Leaderboards: Compete on global PlayFab leaderboards to showcase your character level & loot to the community.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Epic Wonders & The NeverQuests

  • Unique World Landmarks: Journey across Minthra to discover breathtaking world wonders standing at the heart of each Faction’s homeland.

  • Unsolved Mysteries (The NeverQuests): Embark on legendary NeverQuests—ancient, multi-stage quest lines deeply intertwined with the history and lore of each Faction. Enjoy clear, purposeful adventuring that guides you through the world without wasting your time.

  • Loot Hunting: Loot weapons, armor and trinkets as open-world drops from normal enemies, rare spawns and raid bosses.  Items are all randomly rolled, with the potential for a max-roll item.

  • Cosmetics and Unlocks: Earn titles and banners that appear in your player card for online leaderboards. Unlock “Outifts” that change your characters in game appearance including character armor color, hair color, and the color of your attack FX.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

More to discover.....

Neverquest is the result of hundreds of hours of programming, and years of development.  So much heart and passion went into this game.  I can't wait for players to dive into Minthra, and start their adventure.

Thank you for playing and supporting Neverquest, and the ever expanding world of Minthra.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Ben

✨ Starlight Alchemy Studios✨

data.short_description: Neverquest is a charming 2D Pixel Art RPG, set in the high fantasy world of Minthra,  designed to re-kindle those feelings of awe and adventure from playing the great MMORPGs of the early 2000s. Explore a vast open world, recruit & manage a guild of NPCs, discover spells, loot and more.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Dual-core Intel Core i3 (7th Gen) / AMD Ryzen 3 3000 series or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Graphics (Intel HD 620 / AMD Vega 3) with OpenGL 3.3 or Vulkan 1.0 support
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX 11 or 12 compatible on-board audio
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel Core i5 / AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU - NVIDIA GTX 1050 / AMD RX 560 or better
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX 11 or 12 compatible on-board audio
